idle.action: Subtle breathing; head and torso steady; feet planted, seamless quiet loop.

walk.action: Right-facing alternating walk: near-leg contact, far-leg passing with feet close, far-leg contact, near-leg passing.

run.action: Right-facing sprint, forward torso lean; alternating wide contact and narrow passing; same anatomy and scale as idle.

jump.action: One athletic airborne pose, bent elbows, one knee moderately raised with shin down, trailing leg relaxed. No rigid idle hover, no kick, no deep tuck.

doublejump.action: One compact tucked airborne pose, both knees together, arms/props close. Full-size head and anatomy. Runtime supplies the 360-degree rotation.

crouch.action: Lower into guard, hold crouch, small guard shift, return toward crouch-ready stance. Bend joints; do not shrink anatomy.

attack1.action: Light combo opener: wind-up, strike, full impact extension, recovery toward idle guard. Adapt gesture to the character's weapon.

attack2.action: Second combo gesture with a different silhouette: wind-up, strike, impact, recovery at consistent body scale.

attack3.action: Heavier finisher: anticipation, strike, full impact, upright recovery matching idle size.

skill1.action: Prepare, aim, fire/cast, recover. No detached projectiles in the character art; movement release belongs to runtime.

skill2.action: Prepare, wind-up, area-impact pose, recover. No dust, debris, shockwaves or detached effects in the sprite.

ultimate.action: Short cast/command sequence, same head and torso scale. Summoned objects and cut-in are separate assets.

hurt.action: Front hit recoil, backward stagger, regain balance, return to guard. Right-facing, no blood or impact effects.

down.action: Fall backward to left: recoil, fall, land on back, lie flat head left/feet right. Identical anatomy; large gaps between poses.

style: Refined hi-bit pixel art, anime chibi; match the approved NEW character base exactly. Same palette, anatomy, outline weight and pixel density in all states.
